description: Toast notification system + enhanced keyboard shortcuts + batch progress bar + shortcuts help overlay
steps: Create branch feature/alpha-sprint3 from current HEAD (feature/alpha-sprint2)

Create store/useToastStore.ts - a zustand store with: toasts array (id, message, type: success|error|info|warning, createdAt), addToast(message, type) which auto-generates id and sets a 4-second auto-dismiss timer, removeToast(id). Types exported.

Create components/ui/Toast.tsx - renders toast stack in bottom-right corner (fixed position, z-50+). Each toast has colored left border (green/red/blue/yellow based on type), dark bg, white text, auto-dismiss animation (fade out), close button. Stack vertically with gap.
Import and render at root level in App.tsx (after modals, before closing )

Replace all alert() calls in LibraryManager.tsx with useToastStore().addToast() calls: 'Nao ha paginas traduzidas para salvar.' -> warning, 'X pagina(s) salva(s) com sucesso!' -> success, 'Erro ao salvar paginas.' -> error, 'Erro ao carregar capitulo.' -> error
Replace alert() calls in Uploader.tsx: 'Nao foi possivel carregar a imagem...' -> error, 'Nenhuma imagem encontrada no HTML...' -> warning, 'Falha ao baixar as imagens selecionadas.' -> error
Replace alert() in FontManagerModal.tsx: 'Arquivo de fonte invalido ou corrompido.' -> error
Replace alert() in IchigoSettingsModal.tsx with toast error

Extend features/viewer/useViewerShortcuts.ts: add new params (onPrev, onNext, toggleViewMode, toggleCleanMode). Add keyboard handlers for: ArrowLeft -> onPrev (only when not in input/textarea), ArrowRight -> onNext (only when not in input/textarea), Space -> toggleViewMode (only when not in input/textarea and not editingBubbleId), KeyF -> toggleCleanMode (only when not in input/textarea and not editingBubbleId), '?' -> show shortcuts overlay (new param: setShowShortcuts)

In MangaViewer.tsx: pass onPrev, onNext, and new toggle callbacks to useViewerShortcuts. Add viewMode toggle (ORIGINAL <-> TRANSLATED). For cleanMode toggle and shortcuts overlay, lift state from App or use a callback prop.
Add isCleanMode and setIsCleanMode as props to MangaViewer (or use a callback onToggleCleanMode prop), wire F key to toggle it

Create components/ui/ShortcutsOverlay.tsx - a modal/overlay listing all available keyboard shortcuts in a nice grid. Show shortcut key + description. Include: Left/Right arrows (page nav), Space (toggle view), F (fullscreen/clean), Tab/Shift+Tab (bubble nav), Ctrl+Z/Y (undo/redo), Ctrl+B/I (bold/italic), +/- (font size), Delete (remove bubble), Ctrl+Shift+C/V (copy/paste style), Esc (cancel), ? (this help). Render when '?' is pressed.
Add state for showShortcuts in MangaViewer.tsx, pass setShowShortcuts to useViewerShortcuts, render ShortcutsOverlay conditionally

Create components/ui/BatchProgressBar.tsx - a thin progress bar shown at the top of the main content area when images are being processed. Derive count from useSessionStore: processingCount = history.filter(img => img.status === 'processing').length, totalCount = history.length, shows 'Traduzindo X/Y...' with a percentage-width colored bar. Hidden when processingCount === 0.
Render BatchProgressBar in App.tsx inside the main content area, above the viewer content (after the mobile header, before the flex-1 overflow-hidden div)
Run npm run typecheck && npm run build to verify everything passes
Commit all changes with message 'feat: sprint 3 - toasts, keyboard shortcuts, progress bar, shortcuts overlay'
Push branch and create PR against main
acceptance_criteria: npm run typecheck passes with zero errors
npm run build produces a successful production build
Toast store exists and exports addToast/removeToast
Toast component renders in bottom-right, auto-dismisses after 4s
All alert() calls replaced with toast notifications
Arrow Left/Right navigate pages when not in input
Space toggles view mode when not editing
F toggles clean mode when not editing
BatchProgressBar shows during processing, hidden otherwise
New branch feature/alpha-sprint3 created from feature/alpha-sprint2
verification: npm run typecheck && npm run build
findings: All alert() calls replaced with toast notifications. Keyboard shortcuts (ArrowLeft/Right, Space, F, ?) all gated behind isInInput check. Build and typecheck pass cleanly.
